comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Just a reminder: with the recent release of Gran Atlas Chapter 4, we're that much closer to the next UWO expansion: Atlantis. During which, Alchemy will be greatly changed in much the same way Ship Building was changed by Ship Fusion.

Firstly, Alchemy (the skill) will have its level raised to 15 during an Atlantis expansion called "Mediterranean Sea" (set between Chapter 1 and 2 of Atlantis):

Source: gamecity.ne.jp/dol/developer/new_updata2015_05.htm

But the more impressive change will come in Chapter 2: Solar Barca. Alchemists will be able to greatly enhance existing equipment; items can be produced which will have effects such as increasing your walking speed on land, augmenting your power in melee or land battle... there'll even be equipment which will contain Adept of the Ages titles built into them (one piece for all periods of a single century), among other promising things.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost

Thirdly, Private Farms will be tweaked as well. Ascension Island will be able to produce Mandrake goods, for example, while a new fifth farm island is going to be added that has the potential to yield Mandrakes, Sulphur, Silver, Cinnabar... and perhaps other things not yet recorded by Japanese players as of this posting.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm

Now, it's still probably a few months away, and no official announcements on its release have been made yet. With GAMA being a free-to-play server, there is a chance KOEI will decide not every feature be added in (I think I see forging-style options to raise attack and defense stats on equipment; sounds fine to me, but that's been controversial to some folks in the past), much like the Aide Skill addition Alchemy-based recipe which has never materialized on GAMA. Just the same, most, if not all of these features are sure to come in the very near future.

UWO being the sort of game that rewards long-term strategies, Alchemists of old, and those just now starting out, would do well to begin preparing for the upcoming Atlantis expansion now. Your profession has always been a costly and time consuming one, but take heart: it's going to begin to benefit not only you, but your friends, as well as your fellow voyagers (and probably your bank accounts, heh) in ways we never could've imagined.

Cheers, and good voyaging to you all.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Three ways that I know of.

1. Combine Mysterious Gold through Transmutation Alchemy. M.Gold is only obtainable from treasure chests in the Labyrinth, specifically boss rooms after defeating the Minotaur, who rarely appears as it is. (M.Gold was available through past bottle drops once, but that was a while ago.) I hear the process is neither cheap nor easy; haven't done it myself, though.

2. Pick up Orichalcum from treasure chests in the Temple of Poseidon, located in the Acropolis of Atlantis. You must defeat a party of boss NPCs who look like living statues; Talos squadrons, one friend calls them. Not easy to do, but not impossible either; Orichalcum can even rarely be found in normal treasure chests on random dungeon floors, but not in large enough quantities to work with, and the boss room chest drops are more consistent.

3. Ori can randomly spawn from Ancient Tech. Research reward boxes too; the more points you get from "ATR", the better the box reward will be, and the more Orichalcum it can potentially drop (x5 Ori is the best possible drop rate, apparently).

However.... Atlantis is not in the game right now, and therefore you cannot get Ori through method #2 right now. It will appear sporadically in the future, for one month at a time, then disappear again. If GAMA follows the Japanese model, you can look for it to show up in October. Maybe.

Having said that, there are some players who stockpiled Orichalcum and would be willing to sell it. Guess that'd be four ways, then? The price varies, but it's usually expensive; 200m is the highest I've seen it sell for. Prices always vary from seller to seller, of course, so check around.

You can find more detailed information on Orichalcum and Atlantis here (OGP login required): nforum.ogplanet.com/uwo/forum_posts.asp?TID=655058
